events.title: U.S. Jobless Claims Unexpectedly Dip From Upwardly Revised Level
events.description: The Labor Department released a report on Thursday showing first-time claims for U.S. unemployment benefits unexpectedly dipped from an upwardly revised level in the week ended October 3rd. The report said initial jobless claims edged down to 197,000, a decrease of 2,000 from the previous week's revised level of 199,000.

events.title: Canadian Stocks Poised For Weak Open As Oil Surges On Iran Tensions
events.description: Canadian shares face weakness Thursday as Middle East escalation concerns drive oil prices higher. West Texas Intermediate crude jumped 4.8% to $92.52 per barrel amid U.S.-Iran conflict reports. Gold and silver futures show mixed movement.

events.title: U.S. Weekly Jobless Claims Unexpectedly Dip To 197,000
events.description: The Labor Department released a report on Thursday showing first-time claims for U.S. unemployment benefits unexpectedly dipped from an upwardly revised level in the week ended October 3rd.

events.title: PepsiCo Q3 Profit Climbs, Core Margin Down; Updates FY26 View; Stock Gains
events.description:
Snack and beverage major PepsiCo, Inc. reported Thursday higher third-quarter profit and sales, while core operating margin dropped from last year. Further, the firm trimmed fiscal 2026 core earnings per share growth view, and updated revenue growth forecast. 
In pre-market activity on Nasdaq, the shares were trading 2.16 percent higher.

events.title: FTSE 100 Recovers From Early Lows, Down Just Marginally
events.description: The U.K. market's benchmark FTSE 100 recovered early losses thanks to some strong buying at lower levels at several counters. Banks and miners remained weak.

events.title: AngioDynamics Reiterates FY27 Outlook; Appoints Eric Honroth President And CEO - Update
events.description: While reporting financial results for the first quarter on Thursday, medical technology company AngioDynamics, Inc. (ANGO) reiterated its adjusted loss and net sales guidance for the full year 2027, based on its first quarter performance and current outlook for the remainder of the fiscal year.

events.title: CAC 40 Drops On Oil Rally, Bond Yield Surge
events.description: French stocks retreated Thursday as U.S.-Iran tensions and rising oil prices triggered inflation and rate concerns. The CAC 40 fell 0.89% to 7,700.44. Brent crude futures climbed over 5% to $105.20.

events.title: German Stocks Tumble As Oil Prices, Bond Yields Move Up
events.description: German stocks tumbled on Thursday amid rising fears of inflation and interest rates as oil prices surged higher and bond yields rose amid an escalation in tensions in the Middle East. Brent crude front-month futures jumped to $104.50 a barrel, gaining about 4.3%.

events.title: Indian Shares Tumble On Inflation, Rate Worries
events.description: Indian shares slumped on Thursday as a broad global bond sell-off and surging oil prices revived inflation and interest-rate worries.

events.title: Gold Holds Steady In Cautious Trade As Treasury Yields Rise
events.description: Gold prices held steady on Thursday, even as a broad global bond sell-off and surging oil prices revived inflation and interest-rate worries.

events.title: Oil Prices Surge On Fears Of US-Iran Escalation, US Hurricane Threat
events.description: Oil prices surged nearly 4 percent on Thursday amid heightened concerns of U.S.-Iran war escalation.

events.title: Tesco Plc Stock Gains On H1 Profit Growth, FY27 Outlook Upgrade, Addl. Buyback
events.description: Shares of Tesco Plc were gaining around 4 percent in the morning trading on the London Stock Exchange, after the British retail major reported Thursday higher pre-tax profit in the first half of fiscal 2027 and raised annual profit outlook on the back of resilient consumer demand and operational improvements. Further, the firm lifted its share buyback plan.

events.title: European Shares Decline As Inflation, Rate Worries Mount
events.description: European stocks drifted lower on Thursday as a broad global bond sell-off and surging oil prices revived inflation and interest-rate worries.
